description: This PHP source file implements backend logic for managing port forwarding and port trigger rules in a network device configuration interface. It handles actions such as adding, editing, activating/deactivating, and deleting port mapping entries, with validation and interactions with device configuration parameters.

methods.name: PORTTEST
methods.description: A function that checks if two port ranges overlap or if one port range is contained within another, returning 1 if overlapping or contained, 0 otherwise.
